1. Create src/components/chartTable.ts with pure helpers and no comments. Move `shortDate` here and export it so trendCharts.tsx imports it. Export a `ChartTable` type: `{ caption, columns: string[], rows: { key: string; head: string; cells: string[] }[] }`. Add `timeTrendRows(points, format)`, which sorts by t and gives each point its tooltip label, `format(v)` and 'Outside the target' when out is set, else ''. Add `periodBarsRows(bars, unit)`, which gives one row per bar with its label and `${value} ${unit}`. Add `compareRows(series, starts, format, periodWord)`, which gives one row per bucket headed `${periodWord} ${shortDate}`.trim(), with one column per series name and '–' for null. Add `chartSummary({ count, noun, t0, t1, values, format })`, which returns a sentence like '5 points from 2 Nov to 23 Nov. Lowest 4, highest 8, latest 7.' and 'Nothing in this period.' when count is 0. Each helper takes an optional date formatter so tests don't depend on locale.

2. Add src/components/chartTable.test.ts, a new vitest file and no existing test touched, covering A1. Check that TimeTrend rows come out sorted by time even when the input isn't, carry the tooltip label and the formatted value, and say 'Outside the target' only when out is set. Check PeriodBars gives one row per bar with label and value plus unit. Check CompareChart gives one row per bucket with the period word and date, one column per series, and '–' for null; also cover periodWord ''. Check the summary sentence gives the count, date range and lowest, highest and latest value in the given format, and the empty case.

Add `aria-describedby={summaryId}` to each svg, keeping role=img and aria-label; the summary id comes from a `useId` in the chart and is passed down. Build rows and summary with the chartTable.ts helpers in the same format as the tooltips: TimeTrend uses `format`, PeriodBars uses value plus unit, CompareChart uses `format` and `periodWord`. Pass `hasData` as: sorted.length > 0 for TimeTrend, bars.length > 0 for PeriodBars, and for CompareChart starts.length > 0 with at least one non-null value.
